finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The rest of the screenful was just deprecation/dedupe noise, but two real bugs from the bundler bump were breaking the link stage:

1. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }` — fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined` flags; the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false` — now treats `undefined` as disabled.
